standard.$description: Standard. Panel and Reveal's curve — anything that changes shape or enters the page (docs/prd.md §8.5, confirmed against the Motion page's motTokens).

symmetric.$description: Symmetric. The sweepline loop's curve (docs/prd.md §8.5, confirmed against the Motion page's motTokens).

draw.$description: Draw. The blueprint line-draw curve, used only there (docs/prd.md §8.5, confirmed against the Motion page's motTokens).

instant.$description: Instant. Hover fills, chip toggles, row highlights — short enough to feel like a property of the pointer (Motion page motDocs).

control.$description: Control. Buttons and inputs, where several properties change together (Motion page motDocs).

panel.$description: Panel. Anything that changes the shape of the page — dock, drawer, layout shift (Motion page motDocs).

reveal.$description: Reveal. Cards and panels arriving on first paint (Motion page motDocs). The prototype varies this 450–600ms per group weight; 500ms is the documented base step.
